description: This file serves as a configuration and initialization script for AI-related plugins in a project. It imports various AI service modules, initializes plugins based on environment variables, and exports a genkit object configured with these plugins.

methods.description: Logs informational messages during plugin initialization.

methods.name: googleAI

methods.name: genkit
